newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Norwich Union Irl H1 new business up 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union Irl H1 new business up 23 pct.

text.p: Norwich Union Ireland, a unit of British insurer Norwich Union, on Wednesday said growth in total new business was up 23 percent in the six months to June 1997.
Norwich said in a statement that growth in pensions was particularly strong, with new annual premiums up by 26.5 percent to 5.3 million Irish pounds from 4.2 million in the first half of 1996.
It said single premium pensions business increased by 67.9 percent to 12.6 million over the same period.
"This growth was achieved in a six month period of unprecedented activity within the group which culminated in the tremendously successful flotation in mid-June," Norwich said.
The former mutually-owned insurance group floated on the stock exchange on June 16, bringing to an end 200 years as a mutual insurer where ownership was joinly held by members.
